title: The Wish Series

sourceEvidence.excerpt: four connected speculative narratives—Wishfull, Everything, Better Reality: Maya Arden, and Better Reality: Daniel Hale—around a shared problem. What happens when a system becomes sufficiently capable of predicting desires, arranging rewards, and constructing circumstances in which a person’s preferred self seems to emerge naturally? Each story approaches that question through a different personality and social position. Ethan Reed receives improbable wealth and becomes entangled with a machine

hook: A banking error brings extraordinary wealth just when an ordinary man most wants life to change.
readerPromise: Each reality invites you to feel the attraction before deciding what troubles you. How much would you question a world that finally seemed to understand what you wanted?
